# Codex Restore Chat Context

> A Windows Codex Desktop skill for continuing long chats in a new chat, recovering context from a frozen session, and transferring decisions, constraints, and unfinished tasks using the latest native compaction checkpoint plus all available continuation.

This is an independent community tool. It reconstructs readable working context through a separate local recovery session; it does not directly inject encrypted state into the destination chat. Ordinary ChatGPT web/mobile conversations and cross-account or cross-computer migration are outside its scope.

## Prerequisites and model choice

Windows, local Codex session files, a signed-in managed Codex runtime, Python 3.11+, Node.js 18+, and chat-listing tools available to the host agent. The optional zstandard Python package enables compressed session archives.

Prefer Luna for routine host-side history reading and reconciliation. The recovery helper must preserve the source checkpoint model. Known gaps or unread continuation pages prevent a claim of complete transfer. Keep raw recovery bundles private.
